text:
alex: Heads-up: the Ruby SDK Windows job in CI is flaky — test_retry_backoff failing intermittently (2/5). Error is `Timeout::Error` from Net::HTTP while asserting second retry happened.

nora: Which matrix axis? ruby 3.2 / mingw vs wsl?

alex: mingw (native windows runner). Failure log snippet: `Net::ReadTimeout (execution expired) 
  from /usr/local/lib/ruby/3.2/net/protocol.rb:223:in `rbuf_fill'` then our retry never sees the transient 503.

pat: We've seen similar where the test relies on sleeping short intervals and Windows timers have coarse resolution. The test uses `sleep 0.05` between mock responses. Maybe bump to `0.1` or use fake timers.

devrel_alejandra: Also check how our HTTP adapter sets timeouts on Windows. Ruby's Net::HTTP has different default open/read semantics on some builds. If the test assumes immediate socket close, it can race. Two action items: 1) make the test deterministic (use a synchronous stubbed server) 2) add a thing in README about CI quirks on Windows runners.

alex: Good call. I can switch the test to use WebMock to stub responses with delay controlled by test harness instead of real sleeps.

nora: For parity: our Go/JS SDKs assert exponential backoff parameters (initial, multiplier, max) in unit tests. Are we verifying the Ruby client uses the same default backoff curve? Might be a mismatch causing earlier retries to exhaust timeout window.

pat: Current Ruby client sets base_delay = 0.1, factor = 2.0, max_retries = 3. Go uses 0.2 base. Might be why timing differs. We should standardize defaults across SDKs.

devrel_alejandra: Agreed. Please open a small PR to normalize defaults to the platform-neutral profile (base 0.2, factor 2, max_retries 3) and add a unit test asserting the computed delays array for known inputs. Also add a short note in the CHANGELOG about parity.

alex: Will do. Quick patch: in lib/redwood/retry.rb change DEFAULT_BASE = 0.2, add spec. I'll also replace `sleep`-based flaky test with WebMock and time-freeze.

pat: CI rerun queued after change. :gear:

ci-bot: CI: Build #2245 for branch "rb/retry-parity" started. (windows/mingw job queued)

alex: After patch, I saw 10/10 green locally on Windows VM. Will push PR in a bit.

nora: Tiny follow-up: docs quickstart mentions `REDWOOD_RETRY_MAX` env var for configuring retries but not format (seconds vs attempts). Can we make doc clearer (attempts integer) and add example for configuring via initializer?

devrel_alejandra: Adding that to PR too. Example: `Redwood.configure do |c|; c.retries = 3; c.retry_base = 0.2; end` plus env var mapping.

pat: Thanks — this should reduce support tickets from customers hitting our SDK differences.

ci-bot: CI: windows/mingw job for Build #2245 passed. :white_check_mark:
